summary: Fix figure questions and reader jumping. Diagnosis: the Figure 3 caption WAS in the cached full text (page 6); lexical retrieval missed it because a Chinese question shares only the low-IDF word 'figure' with the English caption. Added a deterministic caption anchor (caption_passages) that pulls the passage defining the asked figure/table/equation and puts it first; hardened the client page locator (kind+number, caption-line preference, current-page fallback); and replaced the imprecise scrollIntoView restore with an exact page+offset restore that only re-fits when the width actually changed.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 1fa21d4. Service retrieval + reader/assistant UI; live text-mode calls only (no vision call in this unit).

budget_impact.rationale: Retrieval/prompt and UI logic only; no new operation, no budget or provider change. Text calls used the existing paper_qa ceiling.
budget_impact.before: Figure questions missed the caption; reader jumped on panel toggle.
budget_impact.after: Caption anchored first in the prompt; exact scroll restore; re-fit only on width change.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: Answers now quote the page-6 and page-14 captions

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; retrieval/UI fix, not recommendation quality

open_risks: Scroll restore is exact arithmetic but not visually verified by the agent.
Figures absent from the text layer still cannot be anchored; the current-page image fallback remains.
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
